title: Factorial Logic
statement: Given a non-negative integer n, return n! (factorial of n).
think: What is the task asking? Multiply all integers from 1 to n.
What is the key operation? Accumulate a running product.
What wording signals stand out? Factorial, product, 1 to n.
What is the brute force idea? A simple loop already works well.
What is the better/optimal idea? Iterate from 2 to n and multiply into the result.
What are the edge cases? n = 0, n = 1.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I keep a running product and multiply by each integer up to n.
interview: I would compute factorial iteratively by multiplying all integers from 2 to n into a running result.
ru: Факториал — это произведение всех чисел от 1 до n. Здесь достаточно простого цикла.

important: Use int and overflow too early
nice: Do not mention iterative vs recursive tradeoff

gaps: Nice to have: mention overflow concerns
constraints: Assume result fits in long for the tested values.
whyThisPattern: This is a simple sequential multiplication problem solved by one pass from 2 to n.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because no mapping is needed.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no sequence reversal or pair logic.
